verdict.rationale: Nix has its own command set (nix-env, nix-shell, nix develop, nix run, flakes), and the evidence never shows commands or interface conventions compatible with an incumbent tool such as apt or brew. Running "next to the package manager you already have" is coexistence, an adjacent capability rather than familiar commands. Community comments say switchers "won't like the CLI" and must learn a new language, which points the other way.
